purpose: Merged multi-label training corpus for the Day 9-11 fine-tuned BERT classifier. Combines finance-specific requirements, regulation-grounded synthetic requirements, and Claude-authored synthetic requirements across six domains plus the Day 11 finance augmentation. The external PROMISE-NFR rows were dropped on Day 11 as single-label and off-domain. SEPARATE from ground_truth.json, which stays held out for evaluation.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to apply for personal loans, home loans, and business loans through a unified digital application.
The system shall return a credit bureau score to the loan officer within 2 seconds at the 95th percentile of requests.
The system shall verify the applicant's identity by matching a live facial capture against the photograph on the submitted government identity document.
The system shall calculate EMI schedules based on principal, tenure, and interest rate, and display them to the applicant before loan confirmation.
The system shall process at least 2,000 UPI payment authorisations per second during peak festival season traffic.
The system shall perform liveness detection during video onboarding to confirm a real person is present rather than a photograph or recording.
The system shall verify the borrower's employment status by integrating with the EPFO (Employees' Provident Fund Organisation) database.
The system shall complete end-of-day interest accrual for all savings accounts within a 90 minute batch window.
The system shall extract the name, date of birth, and identity number from an uploaded identity document using optical character recognition and present them to the applicant for confirmation.
The system shall auto-reject loan applications where the applicant's CIBIL score is below the configurable threshold set by the credit risk team.
The loan application form shall render its first meaningful paint within 1.5 seconds over a 3G mobile connection.
The system shall mask the customer's date of birth and full address on every screen visible to first-line support staff.
The system shall disburse approved loan amounts directly to the borrower's bank account within 24 hours of final approval, as mandated by RBI digital lending norms.
The system shall support 10,000 concurrent authenticated customer sessions without degradation of transaction response times.
The system shall encrypt biometric templates using a hardware security module and shall never store the raw biometric image.
The system shall maintain a complete audit trail of all loan status transitions including timestamps, actor IDs, and approval remarks.
The system shall complete a full text search across five years of transaction history and return the first page of results within 3 seconds.
The system shall verify the applicant's PAN against the income tax department database before opening an account.
The system shall generate a Key Fact Statement (KFS) for every loan product and present it to the borrower before disbursement.
The fraud scoring engine shall evaluate each card transaction and return an approve or decline decision within 200 milliseconds.
The system shall authenticate a returning customer using a fingerprint or face scan registered on their enrolled device.
The system shall allow borrowers to prepay or foreclose their loan without any penalty, in compliance with RBI guidelines.
The system shall generate a customer account statement covering a twelve month period within 5 seconds of the request.
The system shall re-verify the customer's identity with a fresh facial capture before processing a change to their registered mobile number.
The system shall send automated repayment reminders via SMS and email 3 days before each EMI due date.
The system shall sustain a throughput of 500 NACH mandate registrations per minute during collection cycles.
The system shall redact identity document numbers from any file exported to an external analytics environment.
The system shall flag accounts with EMI overdue beyond 90 days as Non-Performing Assets (NPA) and notify the collections team.
The nightly reconciliation job shall process up to 5 million settlement records within a 4 hour window.
The system shall verify the applicant's address by matching the uploaded utility bill against the address declared in the application.
The core banking system shall process NEFT transactions in batches every 30 minutes during operating hours.
The system shall complete onboarding identity verification within 60 seconds of document submission at the 90th percentile.
The system shall capture and store the customer's signature specimen for verification against future instruction forms.
The system shall support RTGS transfers of amounts greater than INR 2 lakhs with settlement within 30 minutes.
The system shall ingest 50,000 bulk salary credit instructions within a 10 minute processing window.
The system shall require dual authorisation before any operator can view a customer's unmasked identity document.
The system shall maintain separate general ledger accounts for each product type (savings, current, FD, RD, loan) with daily reconciliation.
The system shall return account balance queries within 500 milliseconds under peak load.
The system shall detect and reject an identity document that has been digitally altered before accepting it for onboarding.
The core banking system shall remain available 24/7 with a maximum unplanned downtime of 15 minutes per quarter.
The system shall re-price the entire retail loan portfolio within 30 minutes of a change in the benchmark lending rate.
The system shall verify that the name on the applicant's bank account matches the name on their identity document before enabling disbursement.
The system shall automatically calculate and deduct TDS on fixed deposit interest exceeding INR 40,000 per financial year.
The payment gateway shall maintain 99.95 percent monthly uptime measured excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
The system shall retain video onboarding recordings for five years from the date of account opening.
The system shall generate daily, monthly, and quarterly regulatory returns for submission to RBI in the prescribed XML format.
The system shall recover from a primary database failure with a recovery time objective of 15 minutes and a recovery point objective of 1 minute.
The system shall archive superseded identity documents while keeping the current version immediately retrievable.
The system shall enforce dual-authorization for all inter-branch fund transfers exceeding INR 10 lakhs.
The customer mobile banking application shall remain functional in read-only mode when the core banking system is unavailable.
The system shall integrate with the national identity authority's verification service over a dedicated leased line.
The system shall support multi-currency accounts and real-time forex conversion using rates published by RBI.
The system shall replicate all committed transactions synchronously to a geographically separate data centre.
The system shall queue identity verification requests when the upstream identity provider is unavailable and process them once service resumes.
The system shall automatically freeze accounts flagged by the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) for suspicious transaction reporting.
The system shall perform rolling deployments without terminating active customer sessions.
The system shall record the outcome of every identity verification attempt, including the provider reference and response code.
The system shall archive transaction records older than 10 years to cold storage while maintaining searchability for regulatory audits.
The UPI payment service shall degrade gracefully by queueing collect requests when the NPCI switch is unreachable.
The system shall offer a reduced interest rate to applicants whose salary account is held with the bank.
The KYC system shall support V-CIP (Video-based Customer Identification Process) as per RBI circular for remote customer onboarding.
The system shall schedule all planned maintenance outside the hours of 06:00 to 23:00 local time.
The system shall cap the total unsecured exposure to any single customer at five times their declared monthly income.
The system shall validate PAN card details against the NSDL/UTIITSL database and flag mismatches for manual review.
The system shall fail over to a standby authentication service within 30 seconds of detecting primary service failure.
The system shall decline applications from applicants below the minimum age or above the maximum age configured for the product.
The system shall perform PEP (Politically Exposed Person) and sanctions screening against OFAC and UN consolidated lists during onboarding.
The system shall retain full payment functionality during the failure of any single availability zone.
The system shall charge a foreclosure fee calculated as a configurable percentage of the outstanding principal.
The system shall trigger periodic KYC re-verification for high-risk customers every 2 years and medium-risk customers every 8 years.
The ATM network monitoring service shall detect and report a terminal outage within 3 minutes of occurrence.
The system shall allow the product owner to define a promotional interest rate valid between a start and end date.
The system shall store all KYC documents in an encrypted document vault with role-based access control and access logging.
The loan application shall allow an applicant to save a partially completed form and resume it later from any device.
The system shall tier transaction charges by customer segment, with premium account holders exempt from domestic transfer fees.
The system shall generate a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) and file it with FIU-IND within 7 days of detection.
The system shall present all fee and interest disclosures in the applicant's selected regional language before requiring consent.
The system shall require a minimum average quarterly balance and shall levy a shortfall charge when it is not maintained.
The system shall monitor all transactions in real-time and flag patterns matching predefined money laundering typologies.
The system shall meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility criteria on all customer facing screens.
The system shall route an application to manual underwriting when the requested amount exceeds the automated approval limit for the applicant's risk grade.
The system shall maintain a customer risk profile that is automatically updated based on transaction behavior and adverse media screening.
The system shall display a progress indicator showing the applicant's current step and the remaining steps in the onboarding journey.
The system shall apply a cashback of a configurable percentage on card spend above a monthly threshold, capped at a maximum amount.
The system shall generate Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) for all cash transactions exceeding INR 10 lakhs in a month.
The system shall provide inline validation messages that identify the specific field in error and the corrective action required.
The system shall allow a customer to select a repayment tenure only from the options permitted for the chosen product and loan amount.
The compliance dashboard shall display pending STR filings, overdue KYC renewals, and regulatory submission deadlines.
The system shall allow a customer to complete video KYC using a mobile device without installing an additional application.
The system shall reduce the credit limit automatically when a customer's internal risk score falls below the configured threshold.
The UPI system shall process collect requests and pay requests within 3 seconds end-to-end.
The transaction history screen shall allow customers to filter by date range, amount range, and counterparty without a page reload.
The system shall recognise revenue from processing fees at the point of disbursement rather than at application.
The system shall validate the beneficiary VPA (Virtual Payment Address) against the NPCI mapper before initiating a transaction.
The system shall support keyboard-only navigation through the entire loan disbursement workflow for assistive technology users.
The system shall allow the pricing team to simulate the portfolio impact of a proposed rate change before publishing it.
The system shall support UPI transaction limits as defined by NPCI — currently INR 1 lakh per transaction for P2P and INR 5 lakhs for specific merchant categories.
The system shall allow a customer to raise a dispute on a transaction directly from the transaction detail screen in no more than three taps.
The system shall waive the annual card fee for the first year and apply it from the second anniversary onward.
The system shall handle UPI dispute resolution within the NPCI-mandated TAT of 5 business days for transaction-related complaints.
The system shall display the total cost of credit, including all charges, on a single screen before the applicant accepts the offer.
The UPI payment gateway shall maintain 99.95% uptime with automatic failover to the disaster recovery site within 15 seconds.
The system shall retain KYC records for eight years following the closure of a customer relationship.
The system shall reconcile all UPI transactions with the NPCI settlement file on a T+0 basis and flag discrepancies for the operations team.
The system shall archive transaction records older than 24 months to cold storage while keeping them retrievable within 24 hours.
The system shall support mandate registration for recurring UPI payments (UPI AutoPay) with customer consent and a configurable maximum amount.
The system shall maintain a golden record for each customer, deduplicating profiles matched on PAN and registered mobile number.
The system shall tokenize credit and debit card numbers using PCI-DSS compliant tokenization and never store raw card data.
The system shall perform a full backup nightly and incremental backups every four hours, with restores tested quarterly.
The system shall support 3D Secure 2.0 authentication for all online card transactions to reduce fraud liability.
The system shall record the lineage of every derived credit risk attribute back to its source system and extraction timestamp.
The system shall detect and block card transactions originating from geographies where the cardholder has not previously transacted, unless whitelisted.
The system shall purge the personal data of rejected loan applicants once the statutory retention period expires.
The card management system shall allow customers to set transaction limits, enable/disable international transactions, and lock/unlock cards via the mobile app.
The system shall validate that every incoming account record conforms to the defined schema and reject non-conforming records with a reason code.
The system shall process credit card billing cycles, generate monthly statements, and calculate minimum due amounts with applicable interest charges.
The system shall maintain referential integrity between disbursement records and their originating loan applications.
The system shall support real-time push notifications for every card transaction including amount, merchant name, and remaining available limit.
The system shall version every change to a customer's KYC document set and retain prior versions for the statutory period.
The wealth management portal shall display a consolidated view of the customer's portfolio across mutual funds, stocks, bonds, and fixed deposits.
The system shall reconcile the customer master between the core banking system and the CRM daily and report discrepancies.
The system shall calculate portfolio returns using XIRR methodology and benchmark them against NIFTY 50 and category averages.
The system shall obtain and record the customer's explicit consent before sharing their financial data with an account aggregator.
The system shall execute mutual fund purchase and redemption orders via BSE StAR MF or NSE MFSS platforms within the applicable cut-off times.
The system shall mask all but the last four digits of the account number on every screen accessible to contact centre agents.
The system shall generate capital gains reports categorized as short-term and long-term for each financial year for tax filing purposes.
The system shall allow a customer to withdraw previously granted data sharing consent and shall cease sharing within 24 hours.
The system shall enforce SEBI-mandated cooling-off period of 15 days for new SIP registrations before the first installment is debited.
The system shall collect only the personal attributes necessary for the requested product and shall not require optional fields for approval.
The system shall encrypt all customer financial data at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The system shall provide a customer with a machine readable export of their personal data within 30 days of a verified request.
The system shall implement session timeout of 5 minutes of inactivity for all authenticated banking sessions.
The system shall log every access to customer personal data with the accessing user, timestamp, and stated purpose.
The system shall enforce multi-factor authentication (password + OTP) for all high-value financial transactions exceeding INR 25,000.
The system shall pseudonymise customer identifiers in all non-production environments used for testing.
The system shall support biometric authentication (fingerprint and face recognition) as an alternative login mechanism for mobile banking.
The system shall notify affected customers and the regulator within 72 hours of confirming a personal data breach.
The system shall log all administrative actions including user creation, role changes, and configuration modifications with tamper-evident audit trails.
The system shall restrict access to customer health information collected for insurance underwriting to authorised underwriters only.
The system shall implement rate limiting on login attempts, locking the account after 5 consecutive failed attempts for 30 minutes.
The system shall obtain separate unbundled consent for marketing communications and shall not condition product approval on it.
The banking platform shall achieve RPO (Recovery Point Objective) of zero data loss and RTO (Recovery Time Objective) of 4 hours for disaster recovery.
The system shall query the CIBIL, Experian, and Equifax bureaus and shall proceed with the first successful response.
The system shall implement geographic redundancy with active-active data centres in two separate seismic zones within India.
The system shall consume the NPCI UPI switch API using mutual TLS authentication for all payment requests.
The system shall maintain end-of-day backup of all transactional databases with encrypted offsite replication.
The system shall publish a disbursement event to the downstream accounting system within 60 seconds of funds release.
The system shall auto-scale compute resources to handle 3x normal traffic during salary days (1st and last week of month).
The system shall retry failed calls to the Aadhaar authentication service using exponential backoff for up to three attempts.
The system shall provide the relationship manager with a 360-degree customer view showing all products, transactions, complaints, and risk scores.
The system shall expose a REST API allowing partner fintechs to originate loan applications on behalf of their customers.
The system shall comply with data localization requirements by storing all Indian customer financial data exclusively within data centres located in India.
The system shall reconcile settlement files received from the card network against internal transaction records daily.
The customer shall be able to download their account statement in PDF, CSV, and OFX formats for any date range within the last 10 years.
The system shall retrieve business turnover data from the GSTN portal for MSME loan underwriting.
The system shall provide a configurable workflow engine for the branch manager to approve account opening, loan sanctioning, and limit enhancement requests.
The system shall open a circuit breaker that stops calls to an external credit bureau after five consecutive timeouts.
The system shall support scheduled fund transfers (standing instructions) with configurable frequency, amount, and validity period.
The system shall accept webhook callbacks from the payment aggregator and shall verify the signature of every callback.
The system shall allow customers to raise and track grievances through an integrated complaint management system with SLA-based escalation.
The system shall synchronise the branch and ATM location master from the enterprise reference data service every 24 hours.
The system shall integrate with the banking ombudsman portal for automated escalation of unresolved complaints beyond 30 days.
The system shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all users initiating a fund transfer above ten thousand rupees.
The insurance underwriting system shall calculate premium based on applicant age, medical history, sum assured, and policy tenure.
The system shall encrypt all cardholder data at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3.
The system shall verify the policyholder's identity against IRDAI's central policyholder database before processing claim payouts.
The system shall lock a customer account after five consecutive failed authentication attempts within fifteen minutes.
The claims processing system shall achieve average claim settlement time of 15 days for non-investigation cases.
The system shall enforce role based access control so that a loan officer cannot approve an application they originated.
The system shall generate IRDAI-mandated monthly premium collection and claims settlement reports in the prescribed template.
The system shall rotate all service account credentials every ninety days without service interruption.
The system shall provide a self-service portal for policyholders to update nominee details, download policy documents, and track claim status.
The system shall scan all uploaded documents for malware before storing them in the document repository.
The system shall support real-time account balance inquiry across all linked accounts with response time under 2 seconds.
The system shall record the geolocation and device fingerprint of every mobile banking login attempt.
The internet banking portal shall be accessible 24/7 with planned maintenance windows restricted to 2 AM-4 AM IST on the last Sunday of each month.
The system shall decline any loan application where the applicant's debt to income ratio exceeds fifty percent.
The system shall provide the compliance officer with a dashboard showing real-time status of all regulatory submissions, pending approvals, and upcoming deadlines.
The system shall apply a risk based interest rate derived from the applicant's credit score band and the requested loan tenure.
The system shall implement data masking on all non-production environments, replacing real customer data with synthetic equivalents.
The system shall allow a relationship manager to view the consolidated portfolio of all customers assigned to them.
The system shall retain all financial transaction logs for a minimum of 10 years as per the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA).
The system shall escalate any loan application pending underwriter action for more than 48 hours to the branch manager.
The mobile banking app shall support offline mode for viewing recent transactions and account balances when network connectivity is unavailable.
The system shall enable a compliance officer to place a hold on any account flagged by the transaction monitoring engine.
The system shall generate automated alerts when system resource utilization exceeds 80% CPU or 85% memory for more than 5 consecutive minutes.
The system shall waive the processing fee for applicants who are existing customers with a relationship older than three years.
The system shall support role-based access control with at least 15 predefined roles (teller, branch manager, compliance officer, auditor, etc.) and custom role creation.
The system shall allow a credit committee member to record an approval decision with a mandatory written justification.
The system shall obtain explicit, granular consent from customers before sharing their data with any third-party service provider.
The system shall support a maker checker workflow in which no single operator can both create and authorise a beneficiary.
The system shall provide customers with a right-to-be-forgotten mechanism that anonymizes their personal data while retaining legally required transaction records.
The system shall apply a late payment penalty automatically once the configured grace period lapses.
The system shall generate a suspicious transaction report in the format prescribed by the financial intelligence unit.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of every change to a customer's risk category, including the actor and the reason.
The system shall produce a daily exception report listing all transactions that bypassed automated approval rules.
The system shall allow an internal auditor to reconstruct the complete decision path of any rejected loan application.
The system shall emit structured application logs to the central observability platform with a correlation identifier per request.
The system shall raise an alert to the on-call engineer when the payment authorisation error rate exceeds two percent over five minutes.
The system shall allow an authorised administrator to configure business rules without a code deployment.
The system shall expose a health check endpoint reporting the status of every downstream dependency.
The system shall allow a customer to schedule a standing instruction for recurring loan repayment on a chosen date each month.
The system shall recalculate and display the revised equated monthly instalment when a customer requests a change in loan tenure.
The system shall block outward remittances to jurisdictions appearing on the sanctions list maintained by the compliance team.
The system shall allow partial prepayment of a loan and shall recompute the amortisation schedule immediately.

The system shall route all loan disbursement and repayment amounts directly between the borrower's bank account and the lender's account, without passing through any third-party or Lending Service Provider account.
The system shall generate a unique reference number for every payment instruction and return it to the initiating channel.
The system shall ensure that any fees or charges payable to a Lending Service Provider are paid directly by the regulated lender and are never collected from the borrower.
The system shall notify the customer by SMS and email within 30 seconds of any debit above the customer configured threshold.
The system shall calculate any penal charges on a delayed loan repayment based only on the outstanding principal amount, not on the full originally sanctioned loan amount.
The system shall allow a customer to freeze and unfreeze their debit card instantly from the mobile application.
The system shall generate and present a digitally signed Key Facts Statement, including the Annual Percentage Rate, to the borrower before loan disbursement.
The system shall support cancellation of a loan application by the applicant at any stage before disbursement.

The system shall offer the borrower a cooling-off period after loan sanction, during which they may exit the loan by repaying only the principal and a proportionate share of the APR, without additional penalty.
The system shall present a consolidated dashboard of outstanding loans, due dates, and payment history to the customer.

The system shall route every borrower grievance related to the digital lending app to a dedicated grievance redressal officer designated by the regulated entity, and shall log the resolution timeline.

The system shall schedule periodic KYC updation for each customer according to their risk classification: at least once every 2 years for high-risk customers, every 8 years for medium-risk, and every 10 years for low-risk.

The system shall ensure that Video-based Customer Identification (V-CIP) recordings are stored exclusively on infrastructure owned or leased by the regulated entity, with no retention of customer data by any third-party cloud or technology vendor.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of every V-CIP verification session, including the identity of the verifying official, the timestamp, and the outcome.
The system shall automatically trigger an enhanced due diligence workflow when a customer is flagged as a Politically Exposed Person or a resident of a high-risk jurisdiction.
The system shall require completed Customer Due Diligence before permitting an occasional transaction of ₹50,000 or more for a walk-in customer without an existing account relationship.

The system shall verify that the mobile number used for Aadhaar OTP-based e-KYC matches the mobile number already on record in the customer's profile before allowing periodic KYC updation through that channel.
The system shall respond to a UPI payment request within 15 seconds and to a transaction-status check within 10 seconds, in line with NPCI's mandated API response times.
The system shall limit transaction-status check API calls to a maximum of 3 attempts per transaction, spaced at least 90 seconds apart.
The system shall generate UPI transaction IDs as exactly 35 alphanumeric characters and shall reject any transaction ID containing special characters.
The system shall block a UPI transfer where the payer and payee accounts are identical, to prevent reward-cashback abuse.
The system shall enforce NPCI's daily limits of 50 balance-check calls and 25 linked-account-view calls per user per app.
The system shall reject any single UPI transaction exceeding ₹1,00,000 or the 20-transactions-per-day-per-user limit set by NPCI.
The system shall restrict AutoPay mandate execution to NPCI-designated non-peak windows: before 10:00 AM, between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM, and after 9:30 PM.

The system shall record explicit, purpose-specific consent from the customer before processing any personal data, and shall allow the customer to withdraw that consent at any time through a self-service interface.
The system shall notify the Data Protection Board of India and all affected customers of any personal data breach within the timeline prescribed under the DPDP Act.

The system shall collect only the minimum personal data necessary for the specific loan, KYC, or payment purpose for which it was gathered, and shall not repurpose that data for another use without fresh consent.
The system shall provide customers a self-service interface to access, correct, and request erasure of their personal data, consistent with data principal rights under the DPDP Act.
The system shall allow a policyholder to submit a new motor insurance claim online by uploading photographs of the damage and a copy of the First Information Report.
The system shall calculate the annual premium for a term life policy based on the applicant's age, sum assured, smoking status, and selected policy term.
The system shall route any claim with an estimated payout above the configured threshold to a senior claims adjuster for manual review before settlement.
The system shall verify the applicant's identity against a government-issued photo ID and tax identification number before issuing a new policy.
The system shall obtain explicit consent from the applicant before retrieving their medical history from an external health information exchange.
The system shall flag potentially fraudulent claims where the same payout bank account appears across three or more unrelated policies within ninety days.
The system shall retain closed claim files and their supporting documents for a minimum of eight years to meet insurance record-retention rules.
The system shall enable a claims adjuster to record inspection findings, attach photographs, and recommend an approval or rejection decision from a mobile device.
The claims portal shall be available twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week, with unplanned downtime not exceeding thirty minutes per month.
The system shall fail over to a secondary data centre within fifteen minutes of a primary-site outage without loss of committed claim data.
The system shall integrate with the reinsurance partner's API to cede the agreed share of every policy that exceeds the company's retention limit.
The system shall generate a monthly regulatory return summarising premiums collected, claims paid, and outstanding reserves for submission to the insurance regulator.
The system shall process at least five thousand premium-payment transactions per hour during renewal peaks without response times exceeding four seconds.
The system shall send policy renewal reminders to the policyholder by email and SMS thirty, fifteen, and three days before the lapse date.
The system shall allow an underwriter to override the automated risk score only with a documented justification that is retained for audit.
The system shall mask the policyholder's bank account number, showing only the last four digits, on every screen except the payout confirmation step.
The system shall support a free-look period during which a new policyholder may cancel the policy and receive a refund of premium less proportionate risk and stamp charges.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of every change to a claim's status, recording the user, timestamp, and previous and new values.
The system shall let a customer service agent view a consolidated timeline of a policyholder's policies, claims, and payments on a single screen.
The system shall encrypt all policyholder health and financial data at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The system shall reconcile premium receipts from the payment gateway against policy records every night and raise exceptions for unmatched transactions.
The system shall provide the actuarial team a self-service dashboard showing loss ratios by product, region, and distribution channel.
The system shall prevent a policy from being issued if the proposer appears on the regulator's sanctions or fraud watchlist.
The system shall allow a policyholder to nominate or update beneficiaries at any time during the policy term through the self-service portal.
The system shall restore service within a recovery time objective of two hours and a recovery point objective of fifteen minutes following a declared disaster.
The system shall apply the no-claim bonus discount automatically at renewal for policyholders who filed no claim in the preceding policy year.
The system shall purge or anonymise the personal data of rejected proposals after one hundred eighty days unless a legal or regulatory hold applies.
The system shall notify the operations on-call team within five minutes when the policy-issuance batch job fails or exceeds its expected run time.
The system shall let a bancassurance partner submit proposals through a dedicated API secured with OAuth 2.0 client credentials.
The system shall record the date, time, and channel of every marketing-communication consent given or withdrawn by a policyholder.
The system shall allow a retail investor to place market, limit, and stop-loss orders for listed equities during market hours.
The system shall reject a buy order when the client's available funds cannot cover the order value plus applicable brokerage and taxes.
The system shall route every client order to the exchange within fifty milliseconds of receipt under normal load.
The system shall sustain at least twenty thousand order messages per second during market open without degrading matching latency.
The system shall authenticate each trading session with two-factor authentication and terminate idle sessions after fifteen minutes.
The system shall maintain a complete, time-sequenced audit trail of every order, modification, cancellation, and trade for a minimum of eight years.
The system shall enforce exchange-mandated price bands and reject orders priced outside the permitted daily range for a security.
The system shall calculate and display the client's real-time margin requirement and available margin before an order is confirmed.
The trading platform shall be available with 99.99 percent uptime during market hours, measured monthly.
The system shall fail over to a hot standby matching engine within thirty seconds of a primary failure with no loss of accepted orders.
The system shall verify with the depository that a client holds sufficient shares in their demat account before accepting a sell order.
The system shall block trading in a client account that the compliance team has flagged for suspected market manipulation.
The system shall generate a daily contract note for each client summarising all trades executed, charges levied, and net obligations.
The system shall let a dealer place orders on behalf of a client only after recording the client's telephonic or written authorisation.
The system shall stream live market data with an end-to-end latency of no more than one hundred milliseconds from exchange feed to client screen.
The system shall obtain client consent before sharing portfolio holdings with a third-party research or advisory provider.
The system shall provide a simplified one-tap order ticket for new investors, with plain-language explanations of each order type.
The system shall halt all trading on the platform when the exchange declares a market-wide circuit-breaker halt.
The system shall reconcile executed trades against exchange trade files at end of day and report any breaks to the operations team.
The system shall allow the risk team to set and adjust per-client and per-symbol exposure limits without a code release.
The system shall retain tick-level market data for three years for surveillance and back-testing purposes.
The system shall notify the client within two seconds of an order being executed, rejected, or expired.
The system shall encrypt all client credentials, bank details, and holdings data at rest and in transit.
The system shall detect and flag wash trades in which the same beneficial owner is on both sides of a transaction.
The system shall let a client download a capital-gains statement for any financial year in a format accepted for income-tax filing.
The system shall provide the surveillance team a dashboard of unusual trading patterns refreshed at least every five minutes.
The system shall complete disaster recovery to an alternate site within a recovery time objective of one hour and a recovery point objective of zero for confirmed trades.
The system shall restrict client trading data so that a dealer can view only the accounts explicitly assigned to them.
The system shall schedule maintenance only outside market hours and publish the maintenance window to clients at least twenty-four hours in advance.
The system shall charge brokerage according to the client's subscribed plan and show the exact charge breakup on every contract note.
The system shall allow a customer to link a debit or credit card to their wallet after a successful one-time-password verification.
The system shall decline a card transaction when the merchant category code is blocked for the cardholder's card product.
The system shall authorise or decline a card payment within two seconds of receiving the request from the merchant terminal.
The system shall tokenise every stored card number so that the primary account number is never retained in application databases.
The system shall comply with PCI-DSS requirements for the storage, processing, and transmission of cardholder data.
The payment authorisation service shall maintain 99.99 percent availability measured on a rolling thirty-day basis.
The system shall fail over to a secondary processing site within sixty seconds of a primary outage without dropping in-flight authorisations.
The system shall settle merchant funds to the merchant's bank account within one business day of transaction capture, net of applicable fees.
The system shall exchange authorisation, clearing, and settlement messages with the card networks in ISO 8583 format.
The system shall calculate and deduct the merchant discount rate and applicable taxes from each settlement batch.
The system shall let a merchant issue a full or partial refund against an original transaction within one hundred eighty days of the sale.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of every authorisation, capture, refund, and chargeback with immutable timestamps.
The system shall block a card after five consecutive declined authorisation attempts within ten minutes to stop card-testing attacks.
The system shall support 3-D Secure authentication for online card transactions where the issuer requires it.
The system shall provide the merchant a self-service dashboard showing settled amounts, fees, refunds, and chargebacks by day.
The system shall notify the merchant within five minutes of a chargeback being raised against one of their transactions.
